subject: Request: subprocessor roster + egress visualization for DPA review

From: Adam Lewis <adam.lewis@finpay.com>

Cc: Legal Team <legal@finpay.com>, privacy@finpay.com
Date: Thu, 6 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: subprocessor roster + egress visualization for DPA review

Hi Marissa —

We're finalizing our DPA review with procurement and privacy, and one outstanding item is a current machine-readable roster of Redwood's subprocessors and a simple visualization showing where customer data may egress (regions/countries) for the hosted product. Specifically, FinPay needs:

- A CSV listing active subprocessors, role (telemetry, CDN, analytics, KMS), country of processing, and whether they are onshore fallback-capable.
- An annotated PDF or diagram that shows egress paths for EU-origin requests vs. US-origin requests (high level is fine).
- Any temporary/subcontractor exceptions in the last 12 months.

Can you provide these by EOD PT next Tuesday (2026-05-11)? If you have a short FAQ or a single slide we can include in the DPA packet, that would help.

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a 20m call if helpful.

Best,
Adam Lewis
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Data Governance
FinPay
